subject: Hiring snapshot + urgent backfill prioritization
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, People Ops <peopleops@acmehr.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hiring snapshot + urgent backfill prioritization

Team —

Attached is the Q4 hiring snapshot I pulled this morning (attachment: hiring_snapshot_Q4.xlsx). We have three immediate asks that need leadership direction before Friday EOD to keep recruiting moving:

1) Product Manager (Backfill, IC4) — urgent. Owner: Markus' team. Candidate pipeline is strong but recruiting needs approval to re-open offer range to remain competitive.
2) Inference SWE (Growth pool) — new headcount request to support Dedicated throughput work; tentative budget comes from infra reserves.
3) Senior Data Platform (Backfill) — People Ops flagged a potential hiring freeze for non-customer-facing infra roles; need an exception or reprioritization.

Key asks: please review the short rationale (tab: "priority_rationale") and respond with one of: APPROVE / DEFER / REJECT for each row. If APPROVE, include any constraints (salary cap, split funding).

Notes: I highlighted the Product PM backfill on the first sheet with Markus' note (attachment: backfill_rationale_Markus.pdf). If we do not approve the PM backfill by Friday, the candidate will likely accept another offer (recruiter says 72-hour window).

Thanks — I kept this tight since QBR prep is starting next week and we need a stable req list for capacity planning.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: hiring_snapshot_Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet), backfill_rationale_Markus.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, People Ops <peopleops@acmehr.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hiring snapshot + urgent backfill prioritization

Rachel — thanks for the summary and the packet. Quick answers inline below; see my attachment (backfill_rationale_Markus.pdf) for details on candidate and expected ramp.

Product Manager (Backfill) — APPROVE, salary cap: $165k base + equity band unchanged. We should push a 72-hour hold as an exception. Recruiter (Emily) is looped to expedite.

Inference SWE (Growth) — DEFER to Q1 unless Vivek prefers we reallocate infra reserve now. Reason: unit economics still under analysis; we can cover temporary load with contractor bench for 8 weeks.

Senior Data Platform (Backfill) — ASK FOR CLARIFICATION: Is this role classified as customer-facing for freeze exemptions? If not, I recommend DEFER.

Markus
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Vivek
